Name: Blood Coated Missile
Description:
You draw a line with two fingers from your outstretched arm, from the wrist to the elbow, focusing mana and blood to form a magical string and a bloody arrow.

The arrow hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. The arrow deals 4d12 force damage to its target, and you take a third of the damage dealt, rounded down, as you use your own blood to fuel this spell.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 2nd.
